_about: A desert biome as pure data (B-1219 stage 2): a UZUWorldGen nature spec in a file -- dry plains, no water, no trees, no snow, more rocks, sand-coloured ground. Feed it as-is: uzu.py map <project> nature --spec ai_loop/presets/map/biome_desert.json (keys starting with _ are metadata and are dropped by the map tool). Regional difference lives in data like this, never in generator code.
